context_requirements: Expression of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase or another non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor-sensitive retroviral enzyme; human cell lines in this panel lack the viral target.
For CYP-mediated effects, expression of the relevant cytochrome P450 enzyme and a co-administered CYP substrate; no such substrate is present in this experiment.
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h after 10 micromolar treatment in multiple cell lines.
A shared transcriptional signature across the nine cell lines that is not explained by vehicle or general chemical stress.
Evidence of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP3A4 or CYP3A5 induction or inhibition producing downstream transcriptional changes in these lines.
